import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
import numpy as np

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

research = data['research_milestones']['data']
industry = data['industry_milestones']['data']
regulatory = data['regulatory_milestones']['data']
investment = data['global_ai_investment']['data']

def to_decimal_year(year, month):
    return year + (month - 1) / 12.0

COLORS = {
    'research': '#1B4F72',
    'industry': '#B35A1F',
    'regulatory': '#922B21',
    'investment_bar': '#D5E8D4',
    'investment_edge': '#82B366',
    'chatgpt_line': '#2C3E50',
    'pre_era': '#FDFEFE',
    'post_era': '#FEF9E7',
    'track_bg_research': '#EBF5FB',
    'track_bg_industry': '#FDF2E9',
    'track_bg_regulatory': '#FDEDEC',
}

TRACK_Y = {'research': 3, 'industry': 2, 'regulatory': 1}

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(22, 13), facecolor='white')
ax = fig.add_axes([0.06, 0.10, 0.82, 0.78])
ax2 = ax.twinx()

chatgpt_x = to_decimal_year(2022, 11)

ax.axvspan(2010, chatgpt_x, alpha=0.03, color='#3498DB', zorder=0)
ax.axvspan(chatgpt_x, 2025.2, alpha=0.06, color='#E74C3C', zorder=0)

for track_name, y_val, bg_color in [
    ('Research Breakthroughs', 3, COLORS['track_bg_research']),
    ('Industry Adoption', 2, COLORS['track_bg_industry']),
    ('Regulatory Action', 1, COLORS['track_bg_regulatory']),
]:
    ax.axhspan(y_val - 0.35, y_val + 0.35, alpha=0.4, color=bg_color, zorder=1)
    ax.axhline(y=y_val, color='#BDC3C7', linewidth=0.5, linestyle='-', alpha=0.5, zorder=1)

inv_years = [d['year'] for d in investment]
inv_vals = [d['investment_bn_usd'] for d in investment]
max_inv = max(inv_vals)

bar_heights_normalized = [v / max_inv * 0.28 for v in inv_vals]
for i, (yr, val, bh) in enumerate(zip(inv_years, inv_vals, bar_heights_normalized)):
    ax.bar(yr, bh, bottom=0.3, width=0.7, color=COLORS['investment_bar'],
           edgecolor=COLORS['investment_edge'], linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.7, zorder=2)
    if val >= 30:
        ax.text(yr, 0.3 + bh + 0.01, f'${val:.0f}B', ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=6.5, color='#27AE60', fontweight='bold', zorder=10)

ax.axvline(x=chatgpt_x, color=COLORS['chatgpt_line'], linewidth=2.5,
           linestyle='--', alpha=0.85, zorder=5)
ax.annotate('ChatGPT Launch\nNov 2022',
            xy=(chatgpt_x, 3.55), xytext=(chatgpt_x + 0.3, 3.7),
            fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['chatgpt_line'],
            ha='left', va='bottom',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=COLORS['chatgpt_line'], lw=1.5),
            zorder=10,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', edgecolor=COLORS['chatgpt_line'], alpha=0.9))

key_research_labels = {
    'AlexNet wins ImageNet (deep CNN revolution)',
    'Transformer architecture published (Attention Is All You Need)',
    'GPT-3 released (175B params)',
    'ChatGPT launched (GPT-3.5-turbo)',
    'GPT-4 multimodal model released',
    'AlphaGo defeats Lee Sedol',
    'GANs introduced (Goodfellow et al.)',
    'DALL·E text-to-image generation',
    'OpenAI o1 reasoning model',
    'Sora text-to-video model previewed',
}

key_industry_labels = {
    'Apple launches Siri',
    'Google acquires DeepMind for ~$500M',
    'Microsoft invests $1B in OpenAI',
    'GitHub Copilot internal preview (Codex)',
    'Microsoft extends OpenAI partnership ($10B+)',
    'NVIDIA market cap exceeds $1T (AI chip demand)',
    'Amazon invests $4B in Anthropic',
    'NVIDIA briefly becomes world\'s most valuable company',
}

key_regulatory_labels = {
    'White House publishes AI future report',
    'OECD AI Principles adopted by 42 countries',
    'EU AI Act proposed by European Commission',
    'US AI Bill of Rights blueprint published',
    'Italy temporarily bans ChatGPT (GDPR concerns)',
    'US Executive Order on Safe AI (Biden)',
    'EU AI Act formally adopted by Parliament',
    'UK AI Safety Summit at Bletchley Park',
}

def plot_milestones(milestones, track_y, color, key_labels, marker='o'):
    xs = []
    for m in milestones:
        x = to_decimal_year(m['year'], m['month'])
        xs.append(x)

    np.random.seed(42)
    jitters = np.random.uniform(-0.15, 0.15, len(xs))

    for i, m in enumerate(milestones):
        x = xs[i]
        y = track_y + jitters[i]
        size = 55 if m['event'] in key_labels else 30
        alpha_val = 1.0 if m['event'] in key_labels else 0.7
        ax.scatter(x, y, s=size, c=color, marker=marker, alpha=alpha_val,

        if m['event'] in key_labels:
            label = m['event']
            if len(label) > 45:
                words = label.split()
                mid = len(words) // 2
                label = ' '.join(words[:mid]) + '\n' + ' '.join(words[mid:])

            offset_y = 0.22 if jitters[i] >= 0 else -0.22
            va = 'bottom' if offset_y > 0 else 'top'

            ax.annotate(label, xy=(x, y), xytext=(0, 10 if offset_y > 0 else -10),
                        textcoords='offset points',
                        fontsize=5.8, color=color, ha='center', va=va,
                        fontweight='bold', alpha=0.85, zorder=10,
                        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white',

plot_milestones(industry, TRACK_Y['industry'], COLORS['industry'], key_industry_labels, marker='D')
plot_milestones(regulatory, TRACK_Y['regulatory'], COLORS['regulatory'], key_regulatory_labels, marker='s')

ax.annotate('', xy=(2016.8, 0.55), xytext=(2012.75, 0.55),

                            connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0'))
ax.text(2014.75, 0.48, '~4 yr gap\nResearch → Regulation', ha='center', va='top',
        fontsize=6.5, color='#7F8C8D', fontstyle='italic', zorder=10)

ax.annotate('', xy=(2023.25, 0.55), xytext=(2022.9, 0.55),

pre_reg = sum(1 for m in regulatory if m['year'] < 2023)

post_i = sum(1 for m in industry if m['year'] >= 2023)
post_reg = sum(1 for m in regulatory if m['year'] >= 2023)

density_text = (

    f'2023–24: {post_r+post_i+post_reg} events in 2 yrs'
)
ax.text(2024.9, 3.65, density_text, ha='right', va='top',
        fontsize=7.5, color='#2C3E50', fontweight='bold',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', facecolor='#FDEBD0',
                  edgecolor='#E67E22', alpha=0.85, linewidth=1),
        zorder=10)

ax.set_xlim(2010, 2025.2)
ax.set_ylim(0.25, 4.0)
ax.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', labelpad=10)
ax.set_xticks(range(2010, 2025))
ax.set_xticklabels(range(2010, 2025), fontsize=9)

ax.set_yticks([1, 2, 3])
ax.set_yticklabels(['Regulatory\nAction', 'Industry\nAdoption', 'Research\nBreakthroughs'],

ax2.set_ylim(0, max_inv * 4.0)

ax2.tick_params(axis='y', colors=COLORS['investment_edge'])
inv_ticks = [0, 25, 50, 75, 100]
ax2.set_yticks(inv_ticks)
ax2.set_yticklabels([f'${v}B' for v in inv_ticks], fontsize=8)

ax.set_title('The AI Convergence: Research, Industry & Regulation (2010–2024)',
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', color='#2C3E50', pad=20)
ax.text(0.5, 1.02,
        'Three tracks that once moved at different speeds converge dramatically after ChatGPT',
        transform=ax.transAxes, ha='center', va='bottom',
        fontsize=10.5, color='#5D6D7E', fontstyle='italic')

    'UK AI Safety Summit at Bletchley Park',
}

    if label_overrides is None:
        label_overrides = {}
    xs = []
    for m in milestones:
        x = to_decimal_year(m['year'], m['month'])
        xs.append(x)

    np.random.seed(42)
    jitters = np.random.uniform(-0.12, 0.12, len(xs))

    for i, m in enumerate(milestones):
        x = xs[i]
        y = track_y + jitters[i]
        size = 55 if m['event'] in key_labels else 28
        alpha_val = 1.0 if m['event'] in key_labels else 0.65
        ax.scatter(x, y, s=size, c=color, marker=marker, alpha=alpha_val,
                   edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.5, zorder=6)

        if m['event'] in key_labels:
            label = m['event']
            if len(label) > 40:
                words = label.split()
                mid = len(words) // 2
                label = ' '.join(words[:mid]) + '\n' + ' '.join(words[mid:])

            override = label_overrides.get(m['event'], {})
            dx = override.get('dx', 0)
            dy = override.get('dy', 10 if jitters[i] >= 0 else -10)
            va = override.get('va', 'bottom' if dy > 0 else 'top')
            ha = override.get('ha', 'center')

            ax.annotate(label, xy=(x, y), xytext=(dx, dy),
                        textcoords='offset points',
                        fontsize=5.5, color=color, ha=ha, va=va,
                        fontweight='bold', alpha=0.85, zorder=10,
